question.problem:
Consider the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{3}=4 \\ {x}_{2}-5{x}_{3}=3 \\ 3{x}_{1}-6{x}_{3}=-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 4 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & 3 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 4 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & 3 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & 3 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -5 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
